messages:
bryan: Heads up 1 1 planning a set of short lightning migration clinics next week for 2 customers showing slow adoption. Aim: rapid unblock, capture action items, surface any renewal risk. Proposed slots: Wed 09:00 PT, Wed 15:30 PT, Thu 11:00 PT. Each 30m.

emma: I can do Wed 09:00 PT. prefer 20m demo + 10m triage.

noah: I9ll take Wed 15:30 PT. I can cover rollback patterns and perf tuning.

carmen: Thu 11:00 PT OK for me. can pair on post-session adoption tasks. I9ll also own notes.

bryan: Draft agenda for 30m: 1) 3m intros + outcome 2) 12m focused demo (model pin, batch/kv cache) 3) 5m quick infra checklist 4) 10m actions + feedback. Keep it tight.

emma: tiny pre-read request: add one-liner on expected token costs and a single curl pre-check. saves 5m.

bryan: good idea. adding pre-check snippet:

```
# pre-check
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/ping -d '{"model":"redwood-small","sample":"hello"}'
```

noah: also will prepare 1-slide rollback checklist and a short snippet showing how to pin a model in the YAML.

carmen: I'll create the notes doc and add an "action owner" table. please tag any renewal concerns with #renewal-risk so CS can escalate.

emma: I9ll build the quick feedback form (three questions). Send 24h after and cc the account owner if score <= 3.

bryan: deploy-bot please create invites with recording + notes link and set reminder 30m before.

deploy-bot: invites created for 2024-11-06T09:00:00-07:00, 2024-11-06T15:30:00-07:00, 2024-11-07T11:00:00-07:00. Notes doc: https://docs.internal/rw-enable/lightning-clinic-nov.

noah: small request 1 could we add a customer-run checklist card (sample prompt, model, token limit) to the invite so they can validate before we start? Cuts back-and-forth.

emma: yes, I9ll add it to the form and the invite.

bryan: Final assignments: Wed 09:00 = Emma (SE) + Bryan (CS); Wed 15:30 = Noah (SE) + Bryan (CS); Thu 11:00 = Carmen (SE) + Bryan (CS). Feedback owner: Emma (builds form). Carmen will post notes and tag #renewal-risk items.

carmen: noted. I9ll summarize actions within 12h and assign owners.

bryan: thanks team. we9ll run these as lightning clinics (30m) to keep momentum and reduce friction. If any session surfaces a clear renewal issue, we9ll route to the AM + Solutions for immediate follow-up. :rocket:
